column7: VerifyPasswordCredentials collapsed a GetUserByUsername STORAGE error into the generic "invalid credentials", so the HTTP handler audited auth.login_failed for a credential it had never checked AND consumed the per-IP login-attempt slot. Fixed with the ErrLoginNotEvaluated sentinel plus a distinct auth.login_error audit and a released attempt slot, matching ErrWebAuthnLoginNotEvaluated's contract (#2565). The anti-enumeration timing property is preserved deliberately: the dummy bcrypt is spent BEFORE the branch, so both outcomes cost the same and the distinction cannot be read back out by latency -- which is exactly why #2745 was left out of the earlier sweep. The client-facing response is unchanged (401, identical body); a storage error is independent of the username supplied so there is nothing to leak. This test asserts the EFFECTS (audit rows written, login_attempts rows left) rather than a status code. Red-proven by mutation
